ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Execution From Internet Hosted WebDav Share
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the "net use" command to mount a WebDAV server and then immediately execute some content in it. As seen being used in malicious LNK files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\cmd\\\.exe.*") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ net\\ use\\ http.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&\\ start\\ \\/b\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\DavWWWRoot\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbs\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps1\\ .*")))
